prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1259; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the motor vehicle collision described in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person. Our client was struck in a head-on impact that, while occurring at low speed, has resulted in ongoing physical symptoms requiring medical evaluation and treatment.

We request that you provide a complete statement of the policy limits applicable to the insured driver, including any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply, together with a copy of the declarations page. Please confirm in writing that your insured's policy information has been disclosed in full.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, repair estimates, recorded statements, claim notes, and any telematics or dashcam footage. Please take steps to ensure none of this material is altered, discarded, or repaired before it can be properly inspected. We look forward to your prompt written response.
